wisp.name: Tether
wisp.what: Tethers Io to an allied unit, granting bonus movement speed to both.

wisp.what: Summon five particle spirits that dance in a circle around Io.

wisp.what: Io gains attack speed, spell amplification, and health regeneration based on max health.

witch_doctor.what: Launches a cask of paralyzing powder that ricochets between enemy units, stunning and damaging those it hits. Damage increases each bounce.
